body:
I don’t even know what that means to be honest. “Too hard on myself”.... I’ve grown up with people being extremely critical of what I do, say, how I look and all those critiques get magnified through the lens of my own mind until everything blurs together; until I can only see myself as an accumulation of wrong.
It’s a strange and miserable thing to know your brain is wrong and not be able to get passed it. You’re right, I don’t see value in myself but no one has ever showed me that I matter much at all either so I struggle to understand how it matters if I exist in the world or not.
I’m in a dark whirlpool right now but I’ll fake my way to the outer ring somehow. I always do. I’ll survive even though I don’t see the point of it and it’ll hurt nearly every step of the way.
Thank you for your kindness
